title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode12 Music For Happiness

rows.Line: Two years earlier
Kanade's Father's Room

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: (Dad's been shut up in his room a lot lately.)

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: (I wonder if he's just busy with work. He's always up working on his songs until late. He seems a bit down, too.)

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: (Oh, I have an idea. Maybe I'll try writing a song for him.)

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: (He was always happy when I did it before. Maybe it'll help cheer him up.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: I'm home, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, hi Dad.
Isn't it rare for you to leave the house for work?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Oh, I managed to win that competition today.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: What? Really?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Yeah. They particularly liked the bit you added, Kanade. They said they're going to use that part in a commercial.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
It's all thanks to you, Kanade. Thank you.
I should be able to get some more work after this.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line:
That's great, Dad!
Oh, I should have made a special dinner or something!

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line:
I'll go buy something to cook.
What sounds good to... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Dad, you look a little pale. Are you feeling okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
No, I'm just a bit tired from lack of sleep.
I'm sure I'll be fine if I lie down for a while.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Are you sure? If you say so...
Two months later

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: And I'm saying it's not possible!

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Wh-What's wrong, Dad? What are you yelling for?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, it's okay, Kanade. It's nothing.
I'm just on the phone about work.

rows.Speaker: Voice On Phone
rows.Line:
We're not trying to be unreasonable.
We'd just like something a little more like the song in the commercial.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Kanade, go back to your room.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: No, this arrangement won't cut it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
They'll never accept it like this.
It needs something new. Something more modern.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Dad, I made some dinner.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: No, this isn't right.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: It's done! I finally did it!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
They can't call THIS old fashioned.
It's probably even better than...

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Dad, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, of course. What is it, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: You've seemed really down lately, so I thought I'd make you a song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: You what?

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: I, uh...was hoping you could listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: S-Sure...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Did you really make this all by yourself?

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah. I only worked on it a little while I was taking breaks from studying, though, so it's not that good.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: You really are amazing, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
You have such a gift, Kanade.
You've really been blessed by music.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh? I don't know about that... Hehe.
Are you feeling a little better?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Kanade, make sure you keep creating your own music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: I'm sure there will be many people who enjoy listening to your music. They're going to need you.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Dad?

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Dad, it's morning. If you don't wake up soon... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Dad!

rows.Speaker: Doctor
rows.Line:
Your father seems to be suffering from overwork.
It's affecting his ability to remember things.

rows.Speaker: Doctor
rows.Line: Thankfully, there's no danger to his mind or body. This sort of thing is a result of psychological stress. With a little rest, most people recover within a few days, but...

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: There are people who don't recover?

rows.Speaker: Doctor
rows.Line: I'm afraid so. They're still able to function day to day, however they have difficulty remembering things properly.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: What am I supposed to do now?

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Dad...

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Hm? Is this Dad's diary?

rows.Speaker: Father's Diary
rows.Line: “7th - I responded to the client's claim that my music sounded too old-fashioned. Still, I can't keep clinging to the same old style forever.”

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: It looks like he was using it for notes about work.

rows.Speaker: Father's Diary
rows.Line: “23rd - I'm finally getting used to working with the computer, but I'm still far from mastering all the different functions. I still have a lot to learn.”

rows.Speaker: Father's Diary
rows.Line: “14th - Kanade helped with the arrangement I was having trouble with. To be honest, I was really surprised. She might have a gift for this.”

rows.Speaker: Father's Diary
rows.Line: “30th - I won the competition, but I'm finding it hard to celebrate.”

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Why?

rows.Speaker: Father's Diary
rows.Line: “The only part they really liked was the section Kanade made. That's her music, not mine.”

rows.Speaker: Father's Diary
rows.Line: “22nd - I've been getting more work since the commercial started airing, but the clients all want something similar to it. I keep telling them I can't, but they insist.”

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: And I'm saying it's not possible!

rows.Speaker: Father's Diary
rows.Line: “They all laugh at how old-fashioned my music sounds, despite the commercial piece being so well polished. What am I missing?”

rows.Speaker: Father's Diary
rows.Line: “8th - Kanade gave me a song she made.”

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: O-Oh...

rows.Speaker: Father's Diary
rows.Line:
“I finally realized what my music is missing.
Why everyone says it sounds so outdated.”

rows.Speaker: Father's Diary
rows.Line: “The music I'm making is all just a cheap imitation of songs I've heard in the past.”

rows.Speaker: Father's Diary
rows.Line:
“But Kanade's is different.
Her music has the ability to touch the hearts of the people of today.”

rows.Speaker: Father's Diary
rows.Line:
“It's all feeling instead of logic.
That isn't something I can imitate.”

rows.Speaker: Father's Diary
rows.Line:
“And yet I have to keep writing music.
I need to make a living so I can take care of Kanade.”

rows.Speaker: Father's Diary
rows.Line: “But is that really the kind of music I want to write? The kind that can make people happy?”

rows.Speaker: Father's Diary
rows.Line:
“I wonder if Kanade could make music like that.
I may not be able to, but she might...”

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Dad...

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Have I been hurting him all this time?

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line:
I... I never meant to!
I was just...

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: I hate this! I don't want it!

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: If only I'd never made that stupid song!

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry... Dad, I'm so sorry...

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: (I just want to disappear.)

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: (I don't even feel hungry.)

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: (I wonder if I can just disappear if I stop eating.)

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Mom's music box... I must have knocked it on the floor.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Dad made this song.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Such a gentle melody. Mom and I both loved this song...that Dad made...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Kanade, make sure you keep creating your own music.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: I've got to make more.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: All this happened to Dad because my songs couldn't bring happiness to anyone.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: I have to be able to write songs that will bring happiness to others.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Songs that can save anyone.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: I must compose... I must compose...

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: I...mustn't ever stop composing...
